brief: Eight AI product types you can sell tomorrow. Product type, audience, price point, build time, where to launch first.

slots.desc1: Automated support bots for local businesses and e-commerce.
slots.desc2: Social copy, blogs, and ad creative generated on demand.
slots.desc3: AI voice agents that book appointments and answer calls.
slots.desc4: Professional avatars and product photography pipelines.
slots.desc5: SaaS boilerplates and AI dev tools for non-coders.

slots.toolTagline: White-label support bots that qualify leads while you sleep.
slots.bigStatement: Sell automated support to local businesses for $500/mo with zero ad spend.
slots.use1Body: Capture and score leads inside WhatsApp and web chat.
slots.use2Body: Let customers schedule appointments without human intervention.
slots.use3Body: Answer 80% of repetitive questions instantly and accurately.

slots.toolTagline: End-to-end creative agency powered by generative models.
slots.bigStatement: Produce 30 days of social content in under 2 hours for busy founders.
slots.use1Body: Generate carousels, captions, and hashtags for entire months.
slots.use2Body: Spin up variant images and copy for A/B tests instantly.
slots.use3Body: Turn outlines into SEO-ready articles with source citations.

slots.toolTagline: Human-like calling assistants that handle sales and support calls.
slots.bigStatement: Replace outbound SDRs with AI that books meetings for $0.15/min.
slots.use1Body: Dial leads, pitch services, and book calendar slots automatically.
slots.use2Body: Answer billing and troubleshooting calls around the clock.
slots.use3Body: Reduce no-shows with personalized appointment reminder calls.

slots.toolTagline: Generate professional headshots and product photography at scale.
slots.bigStatement: Sell avatar packs and catalog shoots without renting a studio.
slots.use1Body: Turn selfies into consistent corporate portraits in any style.
slots.use2Body: Place items on branded backgrounds with perfect lighting.
slots.use3Body: Resize and localize campaign visuals for every channel.

slots.toolTagline: Ship a full-stack AI app with auth, payments, and LLM hooks included.
slots.bigStatement: Sell boilerplate code to founders who want to launch in days.
slots.use1Body: Pre-wired Stripe subscriptions and OAuth login out of the box.
slots.use2Body: Plug-and-play OpenAI streaming with rate limits and memory.
slots.use3Body: Optimized for Vercel edge functions and serverless databases.

slots.toolTagline: Turn messy spreadsheets into executive dashboards and forecasts.
slots.bigStatement: Charge $2k/mo to automate reporting that used to take a week.
slots.use1Body: Connect Sheets and generate weekly P&L summaries instantly.
slots.use2Body: Predict revenue trends with built-in statistical models.
slots.use3Body: Get Slack alerts when metrics drop below target thresholds.

slots.body: Choose a stack, build a landing page, and launch before Monday. Your first customer is already looking.
